scope: CPU/stdlib read-only verification of existing experiment artifacts; only new research evidence directories and this audit written. No model imports, training, GPU execution, checkpoint deserialization, commit or push.
independent_checks: Every declared source ZIP entry and every original artifact content hash, including external checkpoints.
All 240 observations; original frozen spec, target/model helper, quality metric and sustained gate source byte equality to pinned base.
Mode/HQ/TV arithmetic for live and EMA, complete expected observations, all gate/suffix/arrival summary fields.
All 6000 per-update learning-rate/noise rows and recorded initial model/global-RNG hashes.
Every candidate public-package hash equal between each image and its ring; recipe differences limited to z_dim, particle count and batch.
Lossless compressed bytes equal original JSONL; archived metadata/source bytes unchanged.
limits: No independent regenerated samples or RMSE computation; audit checks retained numerical observations, source fidelity and provenance.
Four image passes do not establish full 22-task qualification or long-run/repeated-change behavior.
DV6 uses constant input 0 / output .029; RP4/RP5/C7 use fixed 360/720 noise initialization. Scores retain these declared learner-wide differences.
Original artifact-sha256.json names original uncompressed files and external checkpoints; each archive-manifest.json maps retained files and compression hashes.
Post-run assessment.json supplements are preserved and explicitly labeled as not in the original artifact manifest.
loss_clarification: The raw card prior_weight=.05 is replaced by recipe.prior_reg in the historical public comparator. All candidates audited here and pinned public KA2 have prior_reg0; the overbroad no-auxiliary-loss wording does not invalidate the observations.
